description: T-MEM-22: synthetic retrieval evaluation of docs/memory-engine.md (Verification). Three invented conversations, each with 20 memories, one episode and 20 user messages; `relevant` names the items a reply to that message should see. Recall at 8 counts the relevant items among the first 8 selected. Most messages share at least one word stem with their target, among distractors that share others; three are paraphrases with no shared stem (a storm, a birthday, a headache), the known limit of ADR 0011. All people, places and facts are fictional.
